_doc: apx::move table (D93, spec 04b section 5). Speeds are multipliers on Barony's stat-based base speed (DEX, encumbrance, effects, legs/downed scale; Player::PlayerMovement_t::getSpeedFactor). A steady walk covers units_per_second_per_factor world units per second per point of that base (6.75 = 0.135 units per 50 Hz tick, the speed vanilla Barony settles at on plain floor). 1 tile = 16 units. ASSUMED values are marked; measured fits go in C:/Apocrypha/diagnostics/move.

state_speed._crawl_note: downed crawl is 30 percent; it is applied inside the base by apx::combat_glue::speedScale (downed 0.3, legs disabled 0.5), so the state multiplier stays 1.0 to avoid a double scale

direction._strafe_note: ASSUMED; vanilla strafes at half the forward force. Diagonals are normalised, so no diagonal speed bonus.

curves._curves_note: seconds to reach the base speed from rest / to stop from it / to reverse; linear in speed, scaled by ground grip

sprint._sprint_note: SprintMod hold Left Shift, 1.5x, drained 4 per s from stamina (src/apx_stamina.hpp). At 0 sprint stops and stays off until the key is released.

impulse._impulse_note: impulse(vx, vy, ticks): velocity vx,vy units per tick falling linearly to 0 over ticks; distance = |v| * (ticks + 1) / 2 on open floor

legacy._legacy_note: vanilla writers of vel_x/vel_y (knockback fields, dash, strafe, player push, wind) keep their vanilla 0.75 per tick decay

look._look_note: mouse look as vanilla feel: unsmoothed turn = dx * raw_gain * sensitivity/128 radians (clamped), smoothed accumulates gain with half-life of one tick; invert via the reverse-mouse setting
